bestBets.overview: At the time of writing (Wednesday) the track is rated a good 4 and with fine weather forecast it should remain in that condition. FORMAL AFFAIR was sound when heavily backed at Kilcoy first up for Natalie McCall. She'll only be improved and must be kept safe again at her first outing for Tom Button. NICCO NOTA FIGHTER found form quickly in his initial campaign and has tuned up for this with a trial placing. The debutante WHISPERS OF ZIAAN has shown ability at the trials and draws kindly. BOOMING BELIEF is yet to run a bad race and any positive market moves must be respected.

bestBets.overview: MACHINE HEAD worked hard on pace and faded fresh, then gave his all at big odds in the Lightning here last weekend. Take him seriously this time. The speedy ADMITTED draws to advantage and should be in it for a long way. HARTSHORN was a noted drifter in betting when failing to finish off in the Lightning fresh but will be better for the hitout and is proved second up. LOWLANDS is likely to get back from the outside gate but should be strong late, especially if they overdo it up front.

OVERLAND battled away soundly from on speed last time and can give cheek again. OKAY ZOOMER was twice game in defeat before being a safely held fourth last start. BESTOV closed well to just miss last time.

BLACKTHORN ran an improved race when dropping in both grade and journey last weekend and is in with an each-way show again. bestBets.overview: BETTER BREAKOUT scored well over 1250m here before perhaps not quite seeing out the mile at Townsville. He was successful at his only other try at this lesser trip and can bounce back. FOOLS PLAY hasn't been far away at her past two outings and looks nicely placed back a notch in grade. TALONS disappointed two starts ago but was again sound last time and maps well. THE IMPECKABLE has been game in the placings at both runs back from a break and may be able to hold the front from the inside marble.

ODEGAARD drops sharply in trip but he's very honest and should get every chance from the inside alley.

Expect her to be finishing off hard late again. SHE'S A BEAUTY displayed encouraging second up improvement and should get a gun run in transit from the inside alley. FANCY GARTER was a tad disappointing as fave last start but she's seldom far away and can bounce back. SECRET CYPHER may not have appreciated leading two starts ago, then closed well to just miss last time.
